articles.content: Compromise of 3 domain registries allows hackers to walk off with unauthorized certs.

articles.title: Licensing costs driving 90 percent of VMware users to explore options: Survey
articles.content: Users want to "reduce risk and avoid unnecessary disruption" while making changes.
